'''Exosquidra poppets''' were an ingredient of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] [[Calamaria Surprise]].<ref name="Journal9" /> By some point around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Convenient">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> the dish<ref name="ST" />&mdash;the name of which bore similarities to that of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], a [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> that was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a number of types of [[Squid/Legends|squid]]<ref name="Glove">''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]''</ref><ref name="Legacy33">[[Legacy (2006) 33|''Legacy'' (2006) 33]]</ref>&mdash;was available at [[Stargazer Grill Restaurant]] aboard [[Spaceport THX1138]]<ref name="ST" /> in the Outer Rim's [[Fath sector/Legends|Fath sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Earth system]]</ref>

Later, by some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}} is set during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which corresponds to some time between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Calamaria Surprise was also available at [[BanthaQuik!]] food stops that were situated in the [[Lumchugger's Hub]] area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]]<ref name="Journal9" /> of the Outer Rim's [[Obtrexta sector/Legends|Obtrexta sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> Exosquidra poppets were noted in the entry for Calamari Surprise in the food stops' electronic menu system.<ref name="Journal9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Exosquidra poppets were mentioned in "[[Death-Hunter]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Tony Russo]], illustrated by [[Doug Shuler]], and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in the [[February]] [[1996]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal9" />
